name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower | Ape Shit
description:
Ape Shit – Euphoria – Relax 
Dominant Terpenes: Limonene, Caryophyllene, Myrcene
A cross between GG4 x Black Truffle
Ape Shit is a potent relax strain known for its intense, euphoric high and heavy-hitting effects. With bold flavors of earthy citrus and diesel, it delivers a powerful punch that relaxes the body while elevating the mind. 

The cultivars selected for our Euphoria line were chosen for their superior terpene profiles, high testing THC percentages and unique experiences. Euphoria Ultra-Premium Pre-Rolls are made with Full Flower, Never any shake/trim or remediation. Euphoria Brand Pre-Rolls comes in Strain Specific, Unique, Pop Culture packaging designed to appeal to all Cannasseurs.
